[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec parse_music (string: String) : List Nat :=
  match string with
  | "" => []
  | _ =>
    let first_note := string.find "o" 0
    if first_note = -1 then
      parse_music (string.drop 1)
    else
      let note := string.substr 0 first_note
      let note_value := not_map note
      note_value :: parse_music (string.drop (first_note + note.length))
where
  not_map := fun
    | "o" => 4
    | "o|" => 2
    | ".|" => 1
    | _ => 0

parse_music string
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma parse_music_substring
(string: String)
(note: String)
(note_value: Nat)
(h_note: note = "o" ∨ note = "o|" ∨ note = ".|")
: parse_music (string.substr 0 note.length) = note_value :: parse_music (string.substr note.length)
:=
by
induction string generalizing note note_value
